recipes.name: Candied Orange Peel
recipes.flavorProfile: Sweet and chewy with the bitter, perfumed edge of orange peel.
recipes.healthBenefit: Mostly sugar, used in small amounts in cakes and pastries; the peel brings a little fiber.

ingredients.cutPrep: peel of about 5 oranges, cut in strips or dice

ingredients.prepNote: 300 g for the syrup, 50 g to roll

instructions: Cover the peel with cold water, bring to a boil and drain. Repeat twice more to take away the harsh bitterness, pouring each water away.
Dissolve 300 g sugar in the 250 ml water, add the peel and simmer very gently for about 1 hour, until the peel is translucent and the syrup almost gone.
Lift out the peel, roll it in the last 50 g sugar and dry on a rack overnight. Keep in a closed jar for months.

recipes.name: Apricot Jam
recipes.flavorProfile: Sweet and tangy, with soft pieces of apricot.
recipes.healthBenefit: Mostly sugar; apricots bring some carotenes and fiber. A spoonful sweetens with fruit as well as sugar.
instructions: Mix the apricots and sugar and leave 2 hours, or overnight in the fridge, until the juice runs.
Bring to a boil, add the lemon juice and boil hard, stirring, for 15 to 20 minutes, until a drop on a cold plate wrinkles when pushed.
Pour into hot clean jars, close and turn upside down to seal, or process in a water bath.

nutritionHighlights.note: A little, from the apricots' carotenes.

recipes.name: Raspberry Jam
recipes.flavorProfile: Sweet, sharp and deeply fruity, with the seeds left in.
recipes.healthBenefit: Mostly sugar, with some fiber from the seeds.
instructions: Crush the raspberries in a wide pot and bring to a boil.
Add the sugar and lemon juice, stir until dissolved and boil hard for 5 to 8 minutes, until a drop on a cold plate wrinkles.
Pour into hot clean jars and seal.

recipes.name: Red Currant Jelly
recipes.flavorProfile: Clear, tart and sweet, used with game and in sauces as much as on bread.
recipes.healthBenefit: Mostly sugar, with the tartness of currants.
instructions: Simmer the currants with the water for 10 minutes, crushing them, until they burst.
Pour into a jelly bag or cloth-lined sieve and let drip without squeezing for a few hours.
Boil the juice with the sugar for 5 to 8 minutes until it sets on a cold plate, skim, pour into hot clean jars and seal.
recipes.curationNote: The strained skins and seeds are still counted in the nutrients, since the database has no figure for currant juice alone.

recipes.name: Vanilla Ice Cream
recipes.flavorProfile: Rich and smooth, a custard base with clear vanilla.
recipes.healthBenefit: A dessert: it brings calcium and vitamin A from the milk and cream along with a fair amount of sugar and saturated fat.

ingredients.baseName: Milk, whole, 3.25% milkfat, with added vitamin D

instructions: Heat the milk and cream until steaming.
Whisk the yolks, sugar and salt, pour in the hot milk while whisking, return to the pan and stir over low heat until it coats a spoon (about 82 C / 180 F). Do not let it boil.
Strain, stir in the vanilla and chill overnight.
Churn in an ice cream maker and freeze until firm.

recipes.name: Marzipan
recipes.healthBenefit: More than half almonds, so it brings vitamin E, magnesium and mostly unsaturated fat along with the sugar.
instructions: Grind the almonds and sugar together in a food processor until fine and starting to clump.
Add the water a little at a time and knead into a smooth, firm paste.
Wrap tightly and keep in the fridge for up to a month.

recipes.name: Pork Blood Cake (Huyết)
recipes.flavorProfile: Soft and silky like firm tofu, mild and faintly mineral.
recipes.healthBenefit: Very rich in iron, most of it heme iron, which the body takes up more easily than plant iron.
instructions: Stir the salt into the blood, then stir in the water.
Pour into a shallow tray, cover and steam over gentle heat for 15 to 20 minutes, until set like soft tofu.
Cool, cut into cubes and keep in the fridge up to 3 days. Warm through in the soup just before serving.

nutritionHighlights.note: Blood is one of the richest food sources of heme iron.
